_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE erector spinae column volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_erector_columns.py: her model erector-spinae / autochthon labels split by distance from the vertebral midline, 20 / 50 mm; spinalis above L2 only), plus the mapping onto atlas entities.
A KEY, not data. Rule-based: the textbook columns by a distance rule, not fascial planes; badge it.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 labels.
